content: A ‘word embedding’ is a learned representation. It is represented in the form of vector where words that have the same meaning have a similar vector representation. Consider a word embedding model 'word2vec' BIBREF6 trained on a corpus. Word embeddings generated from the model are context independent that is, word embeddings are returned regardless of where the words appear in a sentence and regardless of e.g. the sentiment of the sentence. However, contextual word embedding models like BERT also takes context of the word into consideration.
